name: When should I repair a small drywall hole myself versus hiring a professional?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair a small drywall hole myself versus hiring a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can typically repair very small holes, like those from a nail or screw, yourself using a spackling compound and a putty knife. However, for holes larger than a quarter, cracks longer than a few inches, water-damaged areas, or any repair requiring new drywall sheets, professional help is recommended. Professionals ensure a smooth, durable finish that matches the surrounding wall and prevents future issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small nail holes can be DIY. For larger holes, cracks, water damage, or extensive repairs, hire a professional to ensure a smooth, lasting finish.
